title: Scalar transport preserves the strict augmented quotient Roos complex
statement: For the coefficient isomorphism and exact scalar equivalence G of the finite quotient transport, and any cochain complex P, there is an isomorphism from the image under G of the small Roos complex to the ordinary Roos complex of the image of P. Under this isomorphism the image of the specified small augmentation equals the specified ordinary augmentation. No K-flatness or completeness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 099L and 099M (section-derived-completion-noetherian and lemma-naive-completion); Tag 0A0E (lemma-derived-completion-koszul); integral-heart-local-model clause (2), Completeness, comparison with the explicit quotient Roos augmentation

proof.text: Tensor the normalized finite quotient comparisons with each term of P using the strong monoidal comparison. Monoidal naturality and unitality give compatibility with level units and transitions.

Take the preserved product of the resulting chain isomorphisms. Its projections intertwine the units and one minus shift. In degree i take the diagonal biproduct comparison in degrees i and i-1. Check the two coordinates of the explicit differential to obtain a chain isomorphism. The augmentation has coordinates (unit,zero), giving the claimed equality.

lean.statement:
theorem smallIntegralRoosComparison
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type v) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic ℓ) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic ℓ) E]
    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra (Padic ℓ) F] [FiniteDimensional (Padic ℓ) F]
    (e : Mon.mk (SmallAdicCompletion.Coefficients.integerRing.{u} ℓ E) ≅
      sfbCondensedIntegers ℓ F) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P : CochainComplex (SmallAdicCompletion.Modules ℓ E X) ℤ) :
    let G := Mod.comap (coefficientMap (IntegralConstantModel.pointComparison ℓ F).hom.hom X ≫
      coefficientMap e.inv.hom X)
    let Gc := G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    ∃ b : Gc.obj (SmallAdicCompletion.roos ℓ E X P) ≅
        AdicCompletion.roos ℓ F X (Gc.obj P),
      Gc.map (SmallAdicCompletion.augmentation ℓ E X P) ≫ b.hom =
        AdicCompletion.augmentation ℓ F X (Gc.obj P)
